objective.title: Qualify dimension overflow and typed affine temperature boundaries

declared.summary: Capture independent prechange exponent-overflow RED, add checked arithmetic for all dimension components, introduce typed absolute/interval temperature conversion and arithmetic, verify exact regressions, and complete C03 with durable boundary evidence.
declared.value: Closes the dimensions and quantities capability with explicit integer-overflow behavior and tagged affine semantics, while preserving exact BigInteger values and legacy scalar unit APIs for compatibility.
debtChanges: Legacy scalar UnitDefinition.ToBase/FromBase remains backward compatible and cannot distinguish absolute from interval values; callers must select the tagged TemperatureMeasurement overload.
Bare Quantity encodes physical dimensions but not temperature point/interval kind. Tagged TemperatureMeasurement is required at affine boundaries.
Checked int exponents prevent silent wraparound but are not a general CPU/memory budget policy. No sibling repository integration is implied.
declared.nextAction: Refine and qualify M1-W01-C04 exact comparison and tolerance semantics, using its authorized source provenance and independent boundary oracles.

achievements.achievement: Before modifying the transferred Math sources, a targeted independent public API test observes that DimensionVector exponent overflow is unchecked, with durable RED evidence.
All eight dimension exponents use checked addition/subtraction, and a new tagged temperature API enforces exact affine point/interval conversion and rejects invalid point arithmetic.
Boundary RED turns GREEN, all C03 exact unit tests and the dw.quantities suite pass, foundation regressions pass, and compatibility limits are documented in durable evidence.
Direct DimensionVector overflow and tagged temperature absolute/interval boundary contracts are completed from independent RED through corrected implementation and verification.
The dimensions, quantities and temperature chunk is complete with source-pinned functional qualification and verified overflow and affine boundary behavior, without claiming external AURA adoption.
